// A probe root spelled by hand, three ways: each must be refused.
fn plain() -> &'static str {
    "pub use ipe_runtime::*;\nmod ffi;"
}

fn reflowed() -> &'static str {
    "pub   use\n    ipe_runtime::error::IpeError;\nmod ffi;"
}

fn joined() -> &'static str {
    concat!("pub type IpeTask<A> = ", "ipe_runtime::IpeTask<IpeError, A>;")
}
